WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE KABIRA

A few honest
reasons.

Kabira The International School in Zirakpur combines a nurturing environment, age-appropriate academics, play-based learning, Indian values and experienced educational leadership — not as slogans, but as how the school actually runs.

01

A nurturing beginning

Before anything else, we want your child to feel safe, welcomed and understood — the foundation every other kind of learning depends on.

02

Rooted in values, ready for the world

Modern teaching methods and activity-based learning sit alongside Indian values, good manners and respect — not one instead of the other.

03

Small classes, every child known

With a maximum of around 20 children per class, teachers have the room to notice how each child is really doing, not just the class as a whole.

04

Experienced educational leadership

Kabira is guided by nearly 28 years of teaching, school administration and education management experience — steady hands behind a new school.

EXPERIENCED HANDS, GUIDING KABIRA

A beginning you
can believe in.

Kabira is led by Dr. Rita Rattan, Director & Principal, whose experience spans preschool leadership, classroom teaching, school administration and years of listening to parents.

"Kabira is not just another school in the city; it is a dream I have carried with me through my journey as an educator — a place where every child is known personally, where their individuality is respected, and where they receive the attention they need to explore, learn, grow and bloom." EVERY CHILD IS KNOWN

Every child is different.
Learning should have room for that.

Children differ in pace, confidence, communication and the way they settle into a new environment. At Kabira, we aim to notice those differences — not to label them, but to understand each child individually. For families where a child may need additional support, we aim to be honest about what we can offer, and to have that conversation early.

HOW CHILDREN LEARN AT KABIRA

Play, explore,
then understand.

Every classroom moment is built around how young children actually take in the world — through their hands, their voices and their curiosity.

PLAY & EXPLORE

Curiosity comes first.

Stories, sensory play and hands-on activity give children a reason to ask questions and try things for themselves.

COMMUNICATE & CREATE

Finding their voice.

Conversation, rhymes, art and music help children express what they notice, feel and imagine.

THINK & GROW

Building independence.

Age-appropriate phonics, numeracy and problem-solving grow alongside confidence, kindness and self-help skills.
